problem.title: Does any of this sound familiar?
problem.intro: Identify the technical challenges holding back your business growth.

existing.title: Existing software
bullets: Slow systems that can't handle new load or traffic spikes.
Accumulated technical debt that slows down new feature development.
Critical doubts about how to scale infrastructure efficiently.
The eternal internal debate: refactor the code or rewrite from scratch?

new.title: New software
bullets: Need to validate the technical feasibility of an idea before investing.
Rapid prototyping and choosing the right technology stack.
Designing a solid, scalable architecture from day one.
Defining the exact line between a fast MVP and a robust platform.

approach.title: I help you move from technical uncertainty to a clear plan
approach.body: The biggest mistake in software development is jumping to a solution without properly diagnosing the problem. My approach always starts by understanding the business and technical context to map out a pragmatic, actionable path.

services.title: Technical Services
services.intro: Precise interventions designed to bring technical clarity and unlock your product's growth.

items.title: Diagnosis & Audit
items.description: In-depth evaluation of existing systems to identify bottlenecks, risks and critical areas for improvement.

items.title: Modernization & Refactoring
items.description: Pragmatic strategies to reduce technical debt, update stacks and scale legacy applications safely.

items.title: Architecture Design
items.description: Defining solid technical foundations for new projects, ensuring long-term scalability and maintainability.

items.title: Technical Guidance
items.description: Expert guidance throughout the development cycle for internal teams, ensuring correct implementation of the vision.

steps.title: Free consultation
steps.description: An initial 30-minute call to understand the problem at a high level, the business context, and assess whether my experience is the right fit.

steps.title: Deep Diagnosis
steps.description: Immersion into the code, architecture, infrastructure and team processes to document the current reality (as-is).

steps.title: Technical Plan & Strategy
steps.description: Delivery of a strategic document detailing the desired state (to-be), architectural options, effort estimates and prioritization.

steps.title: Execution & Support
steps.description: Hands-on implementation of proposed solutions, technical mentoring for the internal team, or oversight of the project's evolution.

contact.title: Do you have a technical problem or a software idea you want to bring to life?
contact.body: Leave me a message and I'll reply within 24 hours to arrange an initial, no-obligation assessment.
